description: This file defines a utility class 'FinanicalFunctions' in the package org.apache.fineract.portfolio.loanaccount.loanschedule.domain, providing static methods for loan amortization calculations such as calculating payment amounts (pmt) and number of payments (nop).

classes.name: FinanicalFunctions
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for financial calculations related to loans, such as installment payments and number of payments based on loan parameters.

methods.name: pmt
methods.description: Calculates the fixed monthly payment amount to be paid by the borrower over the loan term, considering interest rate, number of payments, principal, future value, and payment type.

methods.name: nop
methods.description: Calculates the number of payments needed to pay off a loan given the interest rate, EMI amount, principal, future value, and payment type.
